q3.today_for_variants_2_3: A Comparison or Multi-Comp request is accepted: request_composition derives the variant from the comparison catalogue size (0 overview, 1 comparison, 2+ multicomp) and refuses a mismatch (request_composition.py 179-189). The Opal engine then loads the one pinned Overview map for every Opal job (resident_installed.py make_opal_stores and _opal_map_loader; build_resident_package.py ships only overview_map.json), run_doc takes report_type OVERVIEW from it (opal_producer.py), and the request_ref carries request id, revision and attempt only, so the comparison keys never reach the producer (resident_worker.py run_opal). Result: an Overview is rendered; the filer's comparison or multi selection is not rendered. Even with the right map, every YCharts-field element is NOT_AVAILABLE with reason VENDOR_SOURCED because the producer holds no kept YCharts answers (opal_producer.py _entry).

(3) ycharts/generate/resident_worker.py: carry the composition's variant in request_ref (lines 520-522).
